<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~192.103 Da. Searching for formulas that match this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1, indicating ~11‑12 carbons) points to C₁₁H₁₄NO₂, whose calculated exact mass is 192.10245 Da (Δ ≈ 0.5 mDa). This fits the data best. The required format is CxHyOzX, so the formula is expressed as C11H14O2N.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2N</final_answer>
